notice.notARepoBody: doesn't contain a repository. Choose the folder that holds “.git”, or create a new one here.
notice.notFoundBody: doesn't exist (anymore). Maybe it was moved or renamed, or a drive is missing.

empty.title: No repository yet
empty.body: Open a folder, clone a repository, or create a new one.

noMatch.title: No match
noMatch.body: No name, alias, path or group name contains “{{filter}}”.

actions.aliasDescription: The alias appears in the list and on the tab. The folder on disk keeps its name.
actions.groupExisting: Existing: {{groups}}. A new name creates a new group.
actions.groupNone: Repositories in the same group are listed together.
actions.renameScope_one: Applies to the one repository in the group.
actions.renameScope_other: Applies to all {{count}} repositories in the group.
actions.renameMerge: Existing: {{groups}} – using the same name merges the groups.
actions.dissolveBody_one: The repository stays in the list and on disk; only its group assignment is removed. You can assign a group again later.
actions.dissolveBody_other: The {{count}} repositories stay in the list and on disk; only their group assignment is removed. You can assign a group again later.
actions.missingTitle: The folder of “{{name}}” was not found
actions.missingDescription: Expected at {{path}}. Maybe it was moved or renamed, or a drive is missing.
actions.relocateHint: Alias, favorite, group and color are kept.

fetch.title: Fetch
fetch.description: Fetch for {{repos}}. Only the state of the remotes is fetched – nothing changes locally.

pull.title: Pull
pull.description: Pull for {{repos}}, each with its checked-out branch and the repository's pull mode.

sync.missing: Folder not found – the repository was moved or deleted.
sync.conflict_one: Conflict in one file – resolve or abort it in the repository's tab.
sync.conflict_other: Conflict in {{count}} files – resolve or abort it in the repository's tab.
sync.paused: The pull is paused – continue or abort it in the repository's tab.
sync.noUpstream: The checked-out branch doesn't track a remote branch – skipped.
sync.dirty: Uncommitted changes are in the way. Commit or stash them first, then pull.
sync.inProgress: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is still in progress there.

readme.heading: README – {{name}}
readme.linkBody: The link comes from the README and opens in the system's default program:
readme.blockedImages_one: {{count}} image not loaded – the preview fetches nothing from the network
readme.blockedImages_other: {{count}} images not loaded – the preview fetches nothing from the network
readme.noneSelectedBody: Select an entry on the left to read its README.
readme.missingBody: There is no repository at this path anymore. Choose a new location on the entry or remove it from the list.
readme.noneBody: There is no README file in the root folder of this repository.
readme.imageRemote: The preview doesn't load images from the network.
readme.imageLocal: The preview doesn't show images from the repository.
